title: Comparison of total quotient curvature
summary: In this paper, we establish some comparison theorems for the total quotient curvature. Specifically, we examine the behavior of the functional with respect to the total quotient curvature and prove that the background Einstein metric achieves a sharp bound on the total quotient curvature. We prove that if the quotient curvature satisfies a point-wise lower (or upper) bound relative to the Einstein metric, then the corresponding integral inequality holds.
